Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities,

to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

RECOMMENDED SPINDLE DIAMETERS FOR 

WOODWORKING MACHINES WITH ROTATING 

BORED TOOLS 

( First Revision ) 

( ISO Title : Woodworking Machines — Diameters of Spindles 
for Receiving Circular Sawblades) 



National Foreword 

This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 7006-1981 'Woodworking machines - Diameters 
of spindles for receiving circular sawblades' issued by the International Organization for Standardization 
(ISO), was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on the recommendation of the Machine Tools, 
Machine Tool Elements and Woodworking Machines Sectional Committee and approved by the 
Engineering Division Council. 

This standard was first issued in 1974 and was based upon experience of our woodworking 
machines industry with a view to reducing the variety and rationalize the spindle diameters. Consequent 
upon publication of ISO 7006-1981, this standard has been revised by adopting ISO 7006-1981 to bring 
it in line with ISO Standard. 

Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear, referring to this standard, they should be 
read as 'Indian Standard'. 



Adopted 23 August 1983 



© March 1984, 1SI 



Gr 1 



INDIAN STANDARDS INSTITUTION 

MANAK BHAVAN, 9 BAHADUR SHAH ZAFAR MARG

IS: 7228 -1983 
ISO 7006 -1981 



1 Scope and field of application 

This International Standard lays down the 
diameters of the spindles receiving circular 
sawblades for wood. 







2 Diameters of the Spindles 

The diameters given in the table conform to the 
dimensions specified in ISO 2935, Circular 
sawblades for woodworking — Dimensions.
